[SWS_V2xGn_00140] Reception parameters derived from PDU
Status:
DRAFT
Upstream requirements: SRS_V2X_26011
⌈If a packet is received, the V2xGn module shall derive the frame type (EthIfFram-
eType) and the EthIfCtrl (EthIfController) configured in EthIf via the PDU that is
referenced by the V2xGnRxPdu which is identified by the given RxPduId.⌋
